messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — PRD draft for obs console launch is up. I sketched acceptance criteria: latency dashboards, trace flamegraphs, retention UI, basic alert hooks. Need a scope call for the next 2-week sprint. TL;DR: choose 'MVP' (hosted-first) or 'MVP+' (hosted + dedicated features) by EOD tomorrow. @Maria can you confirm compliance must-haves?

Maria Ortiz: I skimmed. Compliance: audit logs + KMS integration required for Private/Dedicated GA. If we scope GA to hosted-only, we can defer KMS/audit exports to post-GA. Flagging them as blockers for Dedicated/Private.

Samir Patel: From infra perspective: we can deliver sampled traces and a retention toggle backend for hosted in 2w. Full export pipeline + long-term retention (~90d) needs infra + storage work ~4w. Suggest split: Hosted GA = 7-day retention UI + sampled traces. Dedicated/Private backlog for exports & KMS.

Pat Nguyen: Sales feedback: enterprise customers expect per-model token cost in the console. They want this called out on the roadmap. Is per-model breakdown MVP or lower priority?

Joan (design): UX note: retention controls need microcopy explaining cost and SLA effects. Drafted copy in the doc (under "Retention UX"). Also suggest an inline modal for 'what changes on longer retention' to reduce support tickets.

Alex Chen: Proposed shot for scope:
- MVP (hosted): latency & per-route dashboards, sampled traces with flamegraph, retention UI with presets (`7d`, `30d`), alert hooks, basic cost/time breakdowns.
- MVP+: add per-model token cost, long-term export (90d+), Dedicated/Private KMS & audit logs.
Vote +1 for MVP (hosted-first) or +1+ for MVP+?

Maria Ortiz: +1 for the hosted-first MVP. We need to mark Dedicated/Private as "blocked by compliance" until KMS/audit is implemented.

Samir Patel: :thumbsup: I'll open infra tickets: `INF-412` (trace sampling backend), `INF-413` (retention toggle + presets). ETA: INF-412 end of sprint, INF-413 following sprint.

Pat Nguyen: For sales: we'll communicate hosted GA with 7-day retention and a roadmap item for per-model cost + exports. That should unblock most deals in the pipeline.

Alex Chen: Action list: I will update PRD acceptance with a gating matrix (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) + rollout plan. Samir to create infra tickets, Maria to confirm exact legal wording for "audit logs" requirement, Joan to finalize microcopy. Re-check scope Tues 10am. Thanks everyone :rocket:

deploy-bot: PRD document created: https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/obs-console-v1 (permissions: product+eng).
